intro.text: A city of the Final Empire and home of its Great Houses, with the imperial highroad running out from its front.
The Lord Ruler's city in the Central Dominance, ruled after his death by Elend Venture as King of the Central Dominance.

description.text: Its nobility was ranked among ten Great Houses, whose standings had long been stable.

Its districts include the Twists, the Ashwarrens, Aspen Row, the Hotel District, Old Gate, the Commercial District, the Cracks, Southbridge, Brassgate, the Industrial District, Blockstreet, the Sootwarrens and Grainfield.
It was the only city in the Final Empire allowed a wall. With eight evenly spaced gates and modest height, the wall served more as a status symbol than as a defence.
Like every major city of the Final Empire, it was built near a number of mines.

items.text: No attacks on Luthadel were recorded under the Lord Ruler. About a year after his death, with Elend Venture as king, the city was besieged by three armies at once, one of them made up of koloss.
The siege ended with the koloss assaulting the city, the only time an enemy army broke through Luthadel's walls.
In time, Luthadel was destroyed by volcanic activity and great fires. Apart from part of Kredik Shaw, forced underground, its last traces vanished when the world was remade.
